mimir.binaryPath.label: Mímir Binary Path
mimir.binaryPath.help: Path to the Mímir binary. Defaults to ~/.mimir/bin/mimir or the system PATH.

mimir.databasePath.label: Database Path
mimir.databasePath.help: Path to the Mímir SQLite database. Defaults to ~/.mimir/mimir.db.

mimir.defaultBank.label: Default Bank
mimir.defaultBank.help: Default memory bank to use when none is specified.

mimir.defaultAgent.label: Default Agent
mimir.defaultAgent.help: Default agent ID to use when none is specified.

name: Mímir Memory
description: Norse-themed agent memory system with day/night cognition. Store, recall, and reflect on memories across isolated per-agent banks.
